mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_call_attempt SET status = 'SUCCESS', actual_model = #{result.model}, provider_request_id = #{result.providerRequestId}, response_payload = #{result.rawResponse}, finish_reason = #{result.finishReason}, input_tokens = #{result.inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{result.outputTokens}, total_tokens = #{result.totalTokens}, latency_millis = #{latencyMillis}, retryable = 0, finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_call_attempt SET status = 'FAILED', actual_model = #{failure.actualModel}, provider_request_id = #{failure.providerRequestId}, response_payload = #{failure.rawResponse}, finish_reason = #{failure.finishReason}, input_tokens = #{failure.inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{failure.outputTokens}, total_tokens = #{failure.totalTokens}, latency_millis = #{latencyMillis}, error_type = #{failure.errorType}, error_code = #{failure.errorCode}, error_message = #{failure.errorMessage}, retryable = #{failure.retryable}, finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_call_attempt attempt JOIN tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item ON item.id = attempt.ai_task_item_id SET attempt.status = 'FAILED', attempt.error_type = 'WORKER_LOST', attempt.error_code = 'WORKER_LOST', attempt.error_message = 'AI worker lease expired before completion', attempt.retryable = 0, attempt.finish_time = #{now}, attempt.update_time = #{now} WHERE attempt.status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt.rerun_operation_id IS NULL AND item.status = 'RUNNING' AND item.rerun_status IS NULL AND item.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND item.lease_until < #{now}

UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_call_attempt attempt JOIN tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item ON item.id = attempt.ai_task_item_id SET attempt.status = 'FAILED', attempt.error_type = 'RERUN_WORKER_LOST', attempt.error_code = 'RERUN_WORKER_LOST', attempt.error_message = 'AI rerun worker lease expired before completion', attempt.retryable = 0, attempt.finish_time = #{now}, attempt.update_time = #{now} WHERE attempt.status = 'RUNNING' AND attempt.rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} AND item.rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} AND item.rerun_status = 'RUNNING' AND item.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND item.lease_until < #{now}
